Triage: `needs-user-decision` + `domain:devx`.

- **Classification**: the card proposes a pm-dispatch SKILL protocol amendment (bounded seat-body template + narration relocation + takeover compaction + a soft size guard). The maintainer raised the underlying problem (quoted in the body) but has not blessed this specific 4-part shape, and per the 2026-08-11 ruling recorded on #7548, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` updates are ADR-class with mandatory human review — so the shape itself is the decision, not an execution detail.
- **Landing/routing**: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (protocol text) + `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (option 4) — both `domain:devx` surfaces. Anchor verified on `origin/main` @ `744b8f5`: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` exists (10 `H2` references), so the proposed report-only H-item has a live host.
- **Dedup**: adjacent SKILL cards #7548 / #7518 / #7498 / #7493 / #7492 cover different subjects (skill-review ruling, shift lessons, four-lens block, target-board gap, queue criterion); none touches seat-body size. No duplicate.
- **Stale-premise**: filed 06:25Z today; premise (seat bodies unbounded) is a protocol fact, not a code fact — nothing to re-verify beyond the script anchor above.
- Not release-blocking (internal process tooling; `target:*` not applicable).
